meta.subtitle: What we noticed before the deep-dive call

operatingBrand.name: Sample Fence Group
operatingBrand.industry: Fence and Gate Installation and Repair Services
operatingBrand.scale: 8 locations across IL, IN, OH, WI
operatingBrand.evidence: Family-owned residential and commercial fence contractor providing installation and repair across the Midwest. Operates as a Home Depot Pro installer.

operatingPlatform.name: Elevate Sample Partners
operatingPlatform.evidence: Operating platform that runs shared services (IT, finance, HR, M&A) across multiple sibling fence brands.

siblingBrands.name: Allied Sample
siblingBrands.integrationSignal: Listed two integration-architect roles on LinkedIn in 2025 — starting to build internally.

siblingBrands.name: Foremost Sample
siblingBrands.integrationSignal: unknown — no public integration footprint found

siblingBrands.name: Florida State Sample
siblingBrands.integrationSignal: unknown — no public integration footprint found

financialSponsor.name: Akoya Sample Capital Partners
financialSponsor.evidence: Private equity firm; acquired Sample Fence Group in Jan 2023. Typical hold period 5–7 years. Industrials and home-services thesis.

forwardLookingTalkingPoints.insight: ComputerEase sits inside Deltek's cloud-migration arc — the same canonical contract object you build today swaps cleanly to Deltek-cloud as a connector change, not a re-platform.
Akoya typically holds portfolio companies 5–7 years; the integration platform you build now becomes an asset valued at exit. Architecture decisions affect the multiple, not just operations.

intelTheBuyerLacks.insight: Allied Sample currently lists two integration-architect roles on LinkedIn — they're starting to build internally. Either the platform consolidates around one vendor, or each brand spends 4× the cost building parallel integrations.
intelTheBuyerLacks.whyTheyLackIt: Internal hiring at sibling brands isn't shared across the platform until acquisitions are integrated.

intelTheBuyerLacks.insight: Three competing PE firms are active in fence consolidation in 2025. The first roll-up with a clean shared-integration story attracts the best M&A targets.
intelTheBuyerLacks.whyTheyLackIt: Competitive-PE intelligence sits in deal databases (PitchBook, Mergr) rarely consulted at the operating-brand level.
